Rae: opened tiny docs PR to add a JS SDK example and fix a broken internal link. netlify preview shows the link still 404. preview: https://deploy-preview/4199 

Tom: which link is 404? I can check the preview logs.

Rae: the in-page anchor `#streaming-examples` on /guides/streaming doesn't jump, looks like the header id changed in the build.

CI-Bot: Netlify deploy started for branch pr/4199  deploy 7012 logs: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/7012

Tom: I scanned the built HTML and the header id became `streaming-examples-1` after the formatter. our anchors are sensitive to identical headings.

Marta: quick fix: update the anchor link to match rendered id or add an explicit id in the markdown. short-term change in PR is fine. long-term: we should normalize heading IDs in mkdocs config.

Rae: pushed a tiny commit adding `{#streaming-examples}` to the heading and updated the link. also added the JS snippet requested in review. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4199

CI-Bot: Netlify deploy succeeded  deploy 7012 finished. preview: https://deploy-preview/4199

Tom: verified anchor works now and the JS snippet code block renders properly. left an approving reaction.

Marta: approved. also opened ticket DOCS-148 to add a docs build check that flags inconsistent generated heading ids.

Rae: thanks all. planning to merge in the 21:00 slot tonight to avoid overlap with the infra deploy. :rocket:
